title: A Static for the Terminal Anew
author: A. M. Blackwood
blurb: Isandro Winterbourne, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
